blockInfo.TON: Timer On-Delay. When IN=TRUE timing starts; Q=TRUE after PT has elapsed. ET shows elapsed time. Resets when IN=FALSE.
blockInfo.TOF: Timer Off-Delay. Q goes FALSE after PT elapses since IN fell to FALSE. ET shows elapsed time.
blockInfo.TP: Timer Pulse. Rising edge on IN starts a fixed-duration pulse of PT on Q. Q cannot be extended during the pulse.
blockInfo.TONR: Retentive On-Delay. ET accumulates while IN=TRUE and holds when IN=FALSE. Q=TRUE when ET≥PT. RESET clears ET.
blockInfo.CTU: Count Up. Rising edge on CU increments CV. Q=TRUE when CV≥PV. R resets CV to 0.
blockInfo.CTD: Count Down. Rising edge on CD decrements CV. Q=TRUE when CV≤0. LD loads PV into CV.
blockInfo.CTUD: Count Up/Down. CU increments, CD decrements CV. QU=TRUE when CV≥PV, QD=TRUE when CV≤0. R resets, LD loads PV.
blockInfo.SR: Set-Reset Latch. S1=TRUE sets Q1, R=TRUE resets Q1. S1 has priority when both are TRUE.
blockInfo.RS: Reset-Set Latch. S=TRUE sets Q1, R1=TRUE resets Q1. R1 has priority when both are TRUE.
blockInfo.R_TRIG: Rising Edge Detector. Q=TRUE for exactly one scan when CLK transitions FALSE→TRUE.
blockInfo.F_TRIG: Falling Edge Detector. Q=TRUE for exactly one scan when CLK transitions TRUE→FALSE.
blockInfo.GT: Greater Than. Q=TRUE when IN1 > IN2. Accepts any numeric type (INT, DINT, REAL…).
blockInfo.GE: Greater or Equal. Q=TRUE when IN1 ≥ IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.EQ: Equal. Q=TRUE when IN1 = IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.NE: Not Equal. Q=TRUE when IN1 ≠ IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.LE: Less or Equal. Q=TRUE when IN1 ≤ IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.LT: Less Than. Q=TRUE when IN1 < IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.ADD: Addition. OUT = IN1 + IN2. Accepts any numeric type (INT, DINT, REAL…).
blockInfo.SUB: Subtraction. OUT = IN1 − IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.MUL: Multiplication. OUT = IN1 × IN2. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.DIV: Division. OUT = IN1 ÷ IN2. Integer division truncates toward zero. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.MOD: Modulo. OUT = IN1 mod IN2. Remainder of integer division. Integer types only (INT, DINT…).
blockInfo.MOVE: Move / Assign. OUT = IN. Copies the value unchanged. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.ABS: Absolute Value. OUT = |IN|. Returns the non-negative magnitude. Accepts any numeric type.
blockInfo.SQRT: Square Root. OUT = √IN. IN must be ≥ 0. REAL input and output.
blockInfo.EXPT: Exponentiation. OUT = IN ^ EXP. Both inputs and output are REAL.
blockInfo.MAX: Maximum. OUT = max(IN1, IN2). Returns the larger of the two values. Any numeric type.
blockInfo.MIN: Minimum. OUT = min(IN1, IN2). Returns the smaller of the two values. Any numeric type.
blockInfo.LIMIT: Limit / Clamp. OUT = clamp(IN, MN, MX). Ensures MN ≤ OUT ≤ MX. Any numeric type.
blockInfo.BAND: Bitwise AND. OUT = IN1 AND IN2, applied bit-by-bit. DWORD operands.
blockInfo.BOR: Bitwise OR. OUT = IN1 OR IN2, applied bit-by-bit. DWORD operands.
blockInfo.BXOR: Bitwise XOR. OUT = IN1 XOR IN2, applied bit-by-bit. DWORD operands.
blockInfo.BNOT: Bitwise NOT. OUT = NOT IN, inverts all 32 bits. DWORD operand.
blockInfo.SHL: Shift Left. OUT = IN shifted left by N bit positions. Zeros fill from the right. DWORD input, USINT shift count.
blockInfo.SHR: Shift Right. OUT = IN shifted right by N bit positions. Zeros fill from the left. DWORD input, USINT shift count.
blockInfo.ROL: Rotate Left. Rotates all bits of IN left by N positions (wrap-around). DWORD input, USINT count.
blockInfo.ROR: Rotate Right. Rotates all bits of IN right by N positions (wrap-around). DWORD input, USINT count.
blockInfo.SIN: Sine. OUT = sin(IN). IN is angle in radians. REAL input and output.
blockInfo.COS: Cosine. OUT = cos(IN). IN is angle in radians. REAL input and output.
blockInfo.TAN: Tangent. OUT = tan(IN). IN is angle in radians. REAL input and output.
blockInfo.ASIN: Arc Sine. OUT = asin(IN) in radians. IN must be in [−1.0 .. 1.0]. REAL.
blockInfo.ACOS: Arc Cosine. OUT = acos(IN) in radians. IN must be in [−1.0 .. 1.0]. REAL.
blockInfo.ATAN: Arc Tangent. OUT = atan(IN) in radians. Output is in [−π/2 .. π/2]. REAL.
blockInfo.SEL: Binary Select. G=FALSE → OUT = IN0; G=TRUE → OUT = IN1. Any numeric type.
blockInfo.MUX: Multiplexer. K selects the output: K=0→IN0, K=1→IN1. K is USINT; inputs are any numeric type.
blockInfo.NORM_X: Normalize. Maps VALUE from the range [MIN..MAX] linearly to [0.0..1.0]. All inputs and output are REAL.
blockInfo.SCALE_X: Scale. Maps VALUE from [0.0..1.0] linearly to the range [MIN..MAX]. All inputs and output are REAL.
blockInfo.REAL_TO_INT: Converts REAL to an integer type by truncating toward zero (e.g. 3.9 → 3, −3.9 → −3).

Contact.NO: Normally Open contact — passes rung power while the variable is TRUE.
Contact.NC: Normally Closed contact — passes rung power while the variable is FALSE.
Contact.Rising: Rising-edge contact — passes power for exactly ONE scan when the variable goes FALSE→TRUE. Has internal edge memory; it will not fire again until the variable drops and rises again.
Contact.Falling: Falling-edge contact — passes power for exactly ONE scan when the variable goes TRUE→FALSE.

Coil.Normal: Writes the rung power to the variable EVERY scan: TRUE while the rung conducts, FALSE while it does not. Do not write the same variable from two rungs — the last one wins.
Coil.Negated: Writes the INVERSE of the rung power to the variable every scan.
Coil.Set: Latches the variable TRUE when the rung conducts. It STAYS TRUE after power is lost — pair it with a Reset coil elsewhere.
Coil.Reset: Latches the variable FALSE when the rung conducts. Pair with a Set coil.
Coil.Rising: Sets the variable TRUE for one scan when rung power goes FALSE→TRUE.
Coil.Falling: Sets the variable TRUE for one scan when rung power goes TRUE→FALSE.

blockNotes.TON: On-delay timer. While IN is TRUE, ET counts up; when ET reaches PT, Q turns TRUE. IN going FALSE resets ET and Q immediately. Typical use: delay an action after a condition appears.
blockNotes.TOF: Off-delay timer. Q turns TRUE immediately when IN is TRUE; when IN drops, Q STAYS TRUE for PT (ET counts during the off-phase), then turns FALSE. Typical use: keep a fan running after stop.
blockNotes.TP: Pulse timer. A rising edge on IN fires Q for EXACTLY PT, regardless of how long IN stays TRUE (retriggers are ignored while the pulse runs).
blockNotes.TONR: Retentive on-delay timer. ET ACCUMULATES across IN=FALSE gaps — losing IN pauses but does not clear the elapsed time. Only the RESET input clears ET/Q.
blockNotes.CTU: Up-counter. Each FALSE→TRUE edge on CU increments CV by 1. Q turns TRUE while CV >= PV. R=TRUE forces CV back to 0. CU held TRUE does NOT keep counting — only edges count.
blockNotes.CTD: Down-counter. LD=TRUE loads CV with PV; each rising edge on CD decrements CV. Q turns TRUE when CV <= 0.
blockNotes.CTUD: Up/down counter. Rising edges on CU increment, on CD decrement. R clears CV to 0, LD loads PV. QU = (CV >= PV), QD = (CV <= 0).
blockNotes.SR: Set-dominant latch. S1=TRUE sets Q1; R=TRUE resets it — but if BOTH are TRUE, SET wins (Q1 stays TRUE).
blockNotes.RS: Reset-dominant latch. S=TRUE sets Q1; R1=TRUE resets it — if BOTH are TRUE, RESET wins (Q1 goes FALSE).
blockNotes.R_TRIG: Rising-edge detector. Q is TRUE for exactly one scan after CLK goes FALSE→TRUE.
blockNotes.F_TRIG: Falling-edge detector. Q is TRUE for exactly one scan after CLK goes TRUE→FALSE.
blockNotes.ADD: OUT = IN1 + IN2, recomputed every scan while the rung conducts. Works on any numeric type; the output type follows the inputs.
blockNotes.SUB: OUT = IN1 − IN2, recomputed every scan while the rung conducts.
blockNotes.MUL: OUT = IN1 × IN2, recomputed every scan while the rung conducts. Watch for overflow on small integer types.
blockNotes.DIV: OUT = IN1 ÷ IN2, recomputed every scan. INTEGER inputs divide with truncation (7/2 = 3). IN2 = 0 is not guarded — avoid division by zero in your logic.
blockNotes.MOD: OUT = IN1 modulo IN2 (remainder). Integer types only make sense here.
blockNotes.MOVE: Copies IN to OUT every scan while the rung conducts. When the rung is off, OUT keeps its last value (it is NOT cleared).
blockNotes.ABS: OUT = absolute value of IN, every scan while powered.
blockNotes.SQRT: OUT = square root of IN (REAL math). Negative input is undefined — clamp it first.
blockNotes.EXPT: OUT = IN raised to the power EXP (REAL math).
blockNotes.SIN: OUT = sine of IN. IN is in RADIANS, not degrees.
blockNotes.ASIN: OUT = arcsine of IN, result in radians. IN must be within [-1, 1].
blockNotes.ACOS: OUT = arccosine of IN, result in radians. IN must be within [-1, 1].
blockNotes.ATAN: OUT = arctangent of IN, result in radians.
blockNotes.MAX: OUT = the larger of IN1 and IN2, every scan while powered.
blockNotes.MIN: OUT = the smaller of IN1 and IN2, every scan while powered.
blockNotes.LIMIT: Clamps IN into the range [MN, MX]: OUT = MN if IN < MN, MX if IN > MX, else IN.
blockNotes.SEL: Binary selector: OUT = IN0 when G is FALSE, IN1 when G is TRUE.
blockNotes.MUX: Multiplexer: K selects which input is copied to OUT (K=0 → IN0, K=1 → IN1).
blockNotes.GT: Q = TRUE while IN1 > IN2. Recomputed every scan — Q is a level, not a pulse.
blockNotes.EQ: Q = TRUE while IN1 = IN2. Avoid EQ on REAL values — use a tolerance comparison instead.
blockNotes.enNote: Execution Control is ON: the block body runs only while EN is TRUE; ENO mirrors EN so following blocks can chain on it.
